verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that several users successfully ported their numbers away from Google Voice, so port-out is possible in practice. All first-party porting docs cover porting numbers into Google Voice, which does not transfer to this port-out story. missing for 10: first-party port-out documentation, evidence of no lock-in or port-out fees, account number/PIN or other gaining-carrier details exposed in the app, independent corroboration of the port-out process.
